checks.lead: Sahle Dengel (Ge'ez: ሣህለ ድንግል; 1778 – 11 February 1855)  was Emperor of Ethiopia intermittently between 1832 and 11 February 1855, towards the end of the Zemene Mesafint. He was largely a figurehead, with real power in the hands of Ras Ali II of Yejju.
